vitrine:
Vitrine Studio command line interface

Usage: vitrine [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  new          Create a new project folder from a template
  render       Render a preview PNG of a page, output image, canvas or store gallery
  export       Export pages, banners and gallery previews for targets and languages
  validate     Validate a project and report infos, warnings and errors
  strings      Exchange translations with translators (CSV, XLIFF)
  import       Import files into the project (`screenshots <dir>`: fastlane, Vitrine Studio or flat folders)
  frames       Import, list and remove device frames (Apple Product Bezels, own frame packs)
  fonts        List the font families text styles can use (bundled and the project's fonts/ folder)
  mcp          Run the MCP server over stdio (for Claude Code / Claude Desktop)
  upload       Upload to App Store Connect / Google Play: `plan` (dry run + confirm token), `execute --confirm <token>`, `log`
  template     Templates: save canvases as a template, list, import, export, remove, insert into the project, new project from a template
  gallery      Template gallery (api.vitrinestudio.app): login with GitHub, logout, list, upload, download
  install-cli  Make `vitrine` available in terminals (macOS: symlink in /usr/local/bin; Windows: user PATH; Linux: ~/.local/bin)
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

Global options:
      --project <DIR>  Project folder (the folder containing `project.yaml`) [default: .]
  -q, --quiet          Print only results and errors
  -v, --verbose        Print more details (every exported file, image sizes)

Global options:

  -q, --quiet          Print only results and errors
  -v, --verbose        Print more details (every exported file, image sizes)
vitrine render:
Render a preview PNG of a page, output image, canvas or store gallery

Usage: vitrine render [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --target <TARGET>  Target id (default: the first target of the project)
      --lang <LANG>      Language (default: the project's default language)
      --page <N>         The output image containing page N (1-based, as in export file names)
      --image <N>        Output image N (1-based: a page, a page group or the banner)
      --canvas           The whole canvas with page boundaries and hatched gaps
      --gallery          The store gallery preview (images side by side with the store gaps)
      --width <PX>       Width in px (images, canvas)
      --max-edge <PX>    Longer side in px (images, canvas); image height for the gallery
      --scale <F>        Factor of the target size (images, gallery) or px per lu (canvas)
  -o, --output <FILE>    Output PNG (default: `<project>/.cache/render/<target>_<lang>_<what>.png`)
  -h, --help             Print help

Global options:
      --project <DIR>  Project folder (the folder containing `project.yaml`) [default: .]
  -q, --quiet          Print only results and errors
  -v, --verbose        Print more details (every exported file, image sizes)
vitrine export:
Export pages, banners and gallery previews for targets and languages

Usage: vitrine export [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --target <ID>      Only this target; repeat for more (default: all targets)
      --lang <LANG>      Only this language; repeat for more (default: each target's languages)
      --out <DIR>        Export folder (default: `<project>/export`, with `--layout fastlane` `<project>/export/fastlane`)
      --layout <LAYOUT>  Folder structure: `standard` (`<target>/<lang>/…`) or `fastlane` (`screenshots/<locale>/…` for deliver, `metadata/android/<locale>/ images/<type>/…` for supply; no gallery previews) [default: standard]
      --no-html          Do not write the `index.html` overview of the exported files
      --no-gallery       Do not write `_gallery.png` store gallery previews
      --gallery-only     Write only the `_gallery.png` previews (no page images; files of earlier exports are kept). Standard layout only
      --force            Render every file, ignoring the incremental export cache
      --format <FORMAT>  Output format (`json`: the full export report) [default: text] [possible values: text, json]
  -h, --help             Print help

Global options:
      --project <DIR>  Project folder (the folder containing `project.yaml`) [default: .]
  -q, --quiet          Print only results and errors
  -v, --verbose        Print more details (every exported file, image sizes)
vitrine validate:
Validate a project and report infos, warnings and errors

Usage: vitrine validate [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --target <ID>
          Only this target; repeat for more (default: all targets)

      --lang <LANG>
          Only this language; repeat for more (default: each target's languages)

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format (`github`, `gitlab`, `junit`: CI reports)

          Possible values:
          - text:   Grouped by target and language
          - json:   The report with counts
          - github: GitHub Actions annotations (workflow commands) plus the text report
          - gitlab: GitLab Code Quality report (JSON)
          - junit:  `JUnit` XML (GitLab, Jenkins, Azure Pipelines, `CircleCI`, Bitrise)
          
          [default: text]

  -o, --output <FILE>
          Write the `--format` report to this file and print the text report (e.g. `--format junit -o validate.xml`)

      --preview
          Validate for previewing: missing screenshots are warnings, not errors

      --strict
          Fail (exit code 1) on warnings too

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Global options:
      --project <DIR>
          Project folder (the folder containing `project.yaml`)
          
          [default: .]

  -q, --quiet
          Print only results and errors

  -v, --verbose
          Print more details (every exported file, image sizes)

vitrine upload:
Upload to App Store Connect / Google Play: `plan` (dry run + confirm token), `execute --confirm <token>`, `log`

Usage: vitrine upload [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  plan     Dry run: what would be uploaded, problems, and the confirm token
  execute  Upload a plan: needs its confirm token (same project state, 30 min)
  refdata  App Store Connect asset types (read-only): the App Asset Library reference data – placement types, groups, display classes, image specs – and how Vitrine Studio's slots resolve against it (ADR 0019)
  log      Past uploads from `<project>/.cache/uploads.sqlite`
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --app-dir <DIR>  App data folder (settings with the store accounts). Default: `$VITRINE_APP_DIR` or the platform folder
  -h, --help           Print help

Global options:
      --project <DIR>  Project folder (the folder containing `project.yaml`) [default: .]
  -q, --quiet          Print only results and errors
  -v, --verbose        Print more details (every exported file, image sizes)

Credentials in CI (instead of the app settings + keychain; they win over the project's account):
  App Store Connect: VITRINE_ASC_KEY_ID, VITRINE_ASC_ISSUER_ID and
                     VITRINE_ASC_KEY (.p8 text or base64) or VITRINE_ASC_KEY_PATH
  Google Play:       VITRINE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT (JSON text or base64) or
                     VITRINE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH
An upload always needs the plan's token: `upload execute --confirm <token> --yes`.
